verdict.rationale: xAI's docs show real agentic capability for working with user data: Collections search over uploaded knowledge bases, attachment_search that auto-triggers an agentic workflow over documents, custom tool calling to 'query your data,' and multi-agent research orchestration — all of which can surface AI-generated insights from a user's own data. However this requires developers to build the integration via API/tools rather than a ready-made in-product insights feature, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality of such data-insight generation. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of insight quality, and evidence of a turnkey (non-API-integration) in-product experience.
